snippet.title: Master of Treasure - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Master of Treasure is a unique upcoming game on steam focused on a deep treasure hunting system, metal detect and find rare coins from many different nations, including rare gems, artifacts, relics, and more. There's also skills including fishing, cooking, and many more! This will be an MMO game supporting hundreds of players per world!

Wishlist Master of Treasure here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363220/Master_of_Treasure/
